name: Tactical Battles
storyline: In a peaceful village nestled deep in the heart of a mythical realm, a quiet life is shattered when the Devil descends in a fiery attack. Your wife and child are taken from you, your home left in ruins. Defeated and broken, you embark on a desperate journey to assemble a team of unlikely heroes: a cunning Wizard, a battle-hardened Robot, the wise Father Nature, and the deadly Hunter. Each ally brings unique strengths—and their own motives. Together, you must traverse war-torn landscapes, battle monstrous enemies, and challenge the Devil himself in a final showdown. Only by uniting your powers can you hope to bring back what was lost—and uncover the truth behind the Devil's wrath.
summary: Tactical Battle is a turn-based RPG where knights, wizards, dragons, and quirky classes like Father Nature clash in strategic combat. Assemble your team, master unique skills and perks, and prepare for an epic showdown against the Devil boss in a world filled with fantasy and challenge.
